lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular centroids distributed across the mid-lateral flank, increasing in diameter and inter-blob distance along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, creating a coordinate-like grid with high-luminance nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, defined by linear strips of high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and low-intensity shadow gradients directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small-diameter, medium-luminance spots, distinct from the larger-scale grid pattern on the primary flank.
